# llms.txt — ADR-aware vibe coding
version: 1.0

## Purpose
Keep intent in the repo. Meaningful changes ship with an ADR in docs/decisions/.

## Load before coding
- AGENTS.repo.md
- docs/decisions/0001-adopt-adr-workflow.md
- Relevant docs/decisions/NNNN-*.md for the area you touch
- docs/decisions/ADR_TEMPLATE.md

## Skills (always on in this repo)
- adr — write plain ADR before commit, stage with code
- unslop — plain prose on docs and user-facing text

## Commit rule
Code + ADR in the same commit or PR. Commit body: ADR-NNNN: summary.
